shortDescription: Federal Reserve and European Central Bank minutes are expected to show policymakers are less urgent about following up September rate increases at this month’s meetings, according to Bloomberg.The shift comes after softer US jobs data and acute stress in French financial markets.

title: Fed, ECB Minutes to Highlight Easing Rate-Hike Bets
